rationale: The only candidate (#15198) is a feature commit adding automatic requirements installation; it renames DESCRIPTION to description and moves requirements to a class attribute, which does not repair any defect in the description-fallback lines.

The only candidate (9f8043e16f2e) adds a feature (cascading SIGTERM to subprocesses) and just renames the blamed handler to a private _slurm_sigusr_handler_fn; it does not repair the configurable-signal logic.

The only candidate (9e96ee69c81d) is a typing clean-up that removes cast() calls and wraps header reads in a _required() None check; it reformats the blamed queue-default expression without fixing any behaviour this change got wrong.
The only candidate d0a0770808c7 is a 'refactor lpm plugin mechanism' that replaces @packages() with @package(name=...) as part of an API redesign, not a defect repair.
The candidate (#15208) is a variable-renaming commit that only joins the keyword-argument call onto one line and renames list_lightningapps to list_apps, with no behaviour change.

The only candidate (9b5c5938ceb7, 'Remove get_device call in switchbot') deletes the `or await switchbot.get_device(address)` fallback three months later without naming any defect, which reads as dropping a workaround that this change added deliberately for the already-connected-at-startup case rather than repairing a bug in it.
adjudication: Later commit removes the fallback this change added without naming a defect: removal of a workaround, not a repair.

rationale: 60b3d6816b0a replaces OpenUV's custom data object with DataUpdateCoordinators, an architectural refactor that makes the manual async_update method unnecessary rather than fixing a defect in it.
The blamed type-annotation lines were deleted by c86a9a318e4f, a refactor that switches to Arroyo's RunTaskInThreads and removes unused dispatch code, not a bug fix.

The fix for fake reauthentication narrows the pre-existing outer `except BraviaTVAuthError` so it covers only connect(); the blamed PSK/PIN connect branch was just re-indented into the new try block and did not cause the spurious reauth.

bd658441bd01 mainly adds a package_name parameter for standalone lightning-app packaging and swaps logger.info for print as a workaround ('check why logging.info is missing'); logger.info was already used before this change, which only added version numbers to the messages.
92df1c10173a changes read_csv's default file filtering and wraps open_csv in a try/except to give a clearer ValueError, a UX/feature change that only re-indents the blamed open_csv call.
The candidate 052145fabd49 only fixes docstring grammar ('return' -> 'returns') across many methods; the new get_resolution_info method itself was never repaired.

Despite its 'fix' prefix, the candidate extends the model-decorating codemod script (adds ALL_SILO_SPECIAL_CASES and an all_silo_model pass, drops the silo_limit filter); the blamed line was a correct rename to the newly public silo_limit attribute.

b8eaabe3c983 adds the interruptible-work feature and replaces the hard-coded internal placeholder preemptible=False with preemptible=self.interruptible, which extends the feature rather than fixing a defect.
40596f05dd94 merges DDPSpawnStrategy into DDPStrategy and deletes the whole file, a refactor; the blamed _set_world_ranks signature was not shown to be defective.
The fix drops the obsolete --force flag from the suggested self-upgrade command, but --force was already in these messages before; this change only inserted the 'setup' subcommand.

Candidate 1 adapts the call site to `.organization.slug` because a later service refactor changed the type of active_organization, and candidate 2 removes the onboarding client-state feature; neither repairs a defect in this refactor.

The fix makes the pre-existing last_org-based logic also inject the organizations:customer-domains feature when a customer domain is used, a gap this change did not create, and the one blamed line it edits is only replaced by the equivalent helper is_using_customer_domain(request).
adjudication: The blamed line is only replaced by an equivalent helper; the fix adds feature-flag propagation this change never contained.

rationale: The change is a revert that restores defensive copy=True slicing as a workaround for an Arrow serialization bug; 75b206e419f8 drops the copy once a custom serializer is in place, a performance clean-up, not a fix of a defect the revert introduced.

This change is a pure customer->region rename; the later commit b6d87b8144f2 changes the decorating script's classification logic (all-silo special cases, no silo_limit filter), which is pre-existing behaviour, not something the rename introduced.

The fix for #31335 (removing Meta constraints/indexes on FKs on MySQL) repairs pre-existing logic; this preparatory 'Refs' commit only extracted _create_missing_fk_index and reformatted the _constraint_names call that the fix later replaced.
bf1323d138f6 is step 4 of a planned column migration that renames app_id_str back to app_id; the blamed app_id_str lookup was correct for its step and nothing is repaired.
aae800d988bc removes the deprecated CategoricalBlock __getattr__ shim as part of a deprecation clean-up; the blamed find_stack_level() call was not faulty.

The change calls subprocess.call(['command','-v','srun']), but 'command' is a shell builtin and not an executable, so detection fails and can raise an uncaught PermissionError on non-SLURM machines; the fix switches to shutil.which('srun').
adjudication: Verdicts agree; decidable_from set to diff: calling the shell builtin "command" through subprocess is visible in the added lines (general Unix knowledge, like the int8 range in case127).

rationale: The candidate (#16346) is a refactor that moves CSVLogger logic into lightning_fabric and inherits from it; it removes the finalize() no-op guard as part of that restructuring, not to fix a defect.
e522a12d177f is a UX rework of lightning connect (progress bar, removal of the --yes option), and the blamed recursive connect() call changes only to drop the removed argument.

fe07466a1449 rewrites the region-to-control producer as a silo-mode service abstraction; its best-effort ModuleDeadlock import fix concerns module-level imports, not the blamed None-guard or the REGION-only check.
The candidate 13458dc72218 centralizes exception handling and only rewrites api.smile_model/api.smile_name as coordinator.api.*, a refactor that keeps the same values.

This change is a pure rename, and both candidates are feature work (an OpenAPI retriever class with caching for CLI help, and printing plus sys.exit in place of exceptions) that carry the renamed lines along.

The fix repairs an iterate-over-None bug elsewhere, but in this file it only corrects the return-type annotation '-> str | None', which already existed before this change and was merely reflowed when the lineno parameter was added.

The change hard-coded 'lightning-app' for the editable-install egg-info lookup and 'lightning_app' for the git repo-name check, so _prepare_lightning_wheels_and_requirements stopped matching the default 'lightning' install and repo, and the 'hot fix' three days later restored 'lightning' as the default through a package_name parameter.
adjudication: Change hard-coded lightning_app/lightning-app, so detection of the main lightning package and repository could never match; the "hot fix" restores lightning as default.

rationale: The candidate e58531f118a0 adds a get_mqtt_data helper and replaces hass.data[DATA_MQTT].client with get_mqtt_data(hass).client, a refactor with the same behaviour.

The new GraphQL blame query left the string arguments (name, owner, ref, path) unquoted, which is invalid GraphQL, and read `.get('blame', [])` even though the query itself nests results under `blame { ranges }`; the fix quotes the arguments and adds `.get('ranges', [])`.

The change builds all_codes with np.arange(c.categories.nunique(), dtype=np.int8), which overflows for categoricals with more than 127 categories; the BUG fix drops the int8 dtype (the later ordered-to-sort edits change behaviour that predates this change).

The change passed mode=brotli.BrotliEncoderMode.TEXT, which the brotli Python module does not define, so the call raises AttributeError; the same-day fix switches to brotli.MODE_TEXT, and spotting this needs knowledge of the brotli library API.

The later commit changes movflags from 'frag_keyframe' (added here) to 'frag_keyframe+empty_moov', but its message ('Use empty_moov in stream recorder') does not say whether this repairs broken recordings or is a format improvement.
The candidate ('hoists args out of else block') is a behaviour-preserving refactor that moves `args = None` ahead of the if/elif chain.
6842cdcb65c6 is a clean-up of ZHA default entity names that removes the custom name property and the _name attribute in favour of _attr_name; it is a refactor, not a fix for the _attr_name override.

Candidate 1 changes the inactive send rate to 10Hz (a behaviour improvement) and candidate 3 is a clean-up; candidate 2 switches counter initialisation from the camera-bus counter this change introduced to the powertrain-bus counter for 'reliable relay open init', which may repair an LKAS-fault case, but its message does not show whether it fixes a defect or tunes behaviour.

None of the candidates repairs the duplicate-segment check: e4b34ce84ab4 swaps capture_message for capture_exception and adds tags to improve diagnostics (its real fix, the threaded configure_scope, is in other code), 6d5b1f3fa37d is a separately planned IntegrityError feature that only touches matching create() lines, and the last two are metrics and code moves.

This change added `features.has('organizations:customer-domains', last_org)`, which can run with last_org=None; the follow-up adds a None guard, but its title says it was driven by stricter parameter validation in test patching, so it is unclear whether production behaviour was actually broken.
bf1323d138f6 is step 4 of a planned app_id to app_id_str migration and renames the column back to app_id; writing app_id_str in step 1 was intended and correct.
01b1c6512c15 deletes the whole DynamicSamplingFeatureMultiplexer module as a refactor; nothing indicates get_enabled_user_biases was defective.

The blamed lines publish the ublox init result as the `UbloxAvailable` param as designed; one candidate only moves them in a test-driven refactor and the other drops the param write because pigeond was later changed not to run without ublox, a redesign rather than a repair of these lines.
adjudication: Later commit redesigns when pigeond runs; the blamed UbloxAvailable write worked as intended.

rationale: The fix repairs transformed-transaction search, a bug outside these lines, and in this file only widens the where-column whitelist from tags[environment] to also accept tags[transaction]; the environment filter and the raise for unsupported columns that this change added are kept and worked as intended.
adjudication: Before the change, non-timestamp where-columns were silently ignored; the change made that explicit and the fix adds transaction support as a new feature.

rationale: 38bee5babc36, a same-day 'fix(backend): session replay banner setting', removes the new is_saas() helper (which reads settings.SENTRY_IS_SAAS), but the bundle does not show whether that setting was missing or wrong (e.g. AttributeError) or was just dropped for another approach.

The refactor set bs = len(dataset) for LoadImages too, making the batch size the number of files instead of 1 (this breaks non-PyTorch backends such as TensorRT, which warm up with batch size bs); the fix restores bs = 1 except for streams, and seeing this needs the dataset's __len__ and the later uses of bs elsewhere in the file and repository.
